format: JSON Lines; each non-empty line is one JSON object

input_files.name: canonical score rows
input_files.contents: Frozen SafeVantage, ConceptGraphs, and VLMaps case scores. Include one row per case and method. Use method values safevantage_full, conceptgraphs_tau1, and vlmaps_tau1.

input_files.name: caption-RAG score rows
input_files.contents: Frozen caption-RAG score for each case_id shared with the canonical score rows. scene_id and gt_present may be included and, when present, must agree with the canonical row.

construction: Obtain HM3D-Sem through its official access process and follow its dataset terms.
Generate the per-case score streams using the corresponding frozen method implementations and the same case IDs, scene IDs, and ground-truth labels across methods.
Export canonical rows with case_id, scene_id, gt_present, method, and the method-specific score field. Export caption-RAG rows with case_id and score.
hm3d_multisplit.scope: The evaluator analyzes frozen score streams; it does not render HM3D scenes or generate SafeVantage, ConceptGraphs, VLMaps, or caption-RAG scores.

input_file.name: prepared four-state episode records
input_file.contents: Frozen episode-level observability records with a disjoint six-scene development split and twelve-scene test split.

construction: Request ScanNet access through its official process and follow its terms.
Prepare the frozen four-state episode records using the registered episode construction and observability protocol; raw scans alone are not this evaluator's input.
Write one JSON object per episode with split, scene_id, epistemic_state, max_p_clear, coverage_fraction, and source_coverage_fraction.
scannet_negative_closure.scope: The audit selects its rule on development episodes and evaluates once on the locked test episodes. It does not create episodes from raw scans.
